name: Burning Foundation Environmental Programs
summary: Grants of USD 5,000 to 15,000 to 501(c)(3) public charities in Washington and Oregon that preserve habitat that supports biodiversity, with preference for local and statewide groups. Two letter-of-interest cycles a year.

calls.label: Spring and fall cycles (letter of interest, then full proposal)
calls.recurring: Portal opens March 1 and September 1; letters of interest due the last Friday of March and of September; full proposals due the first Wednesday of May and of November.

applicant_types.quote: 501(c)(3) groups (that are classified as a Public Charity under 509(a)(1) or 509(a)(2)) throughout Washington and Oregon who meet the stated areas of interest.

geography.quote: preservation of habitat that supports biodiversity and quiet remote recreation in Washington or Oregon

access.quote: All applicants must fill out a letter of interest by the Spring or Fall due date.
